title: At the Lab
sections: A Trip Home Through the Vortex
大家拴在一起穿过漩涡回到Edgewood，再传送至Zann父母的实验室。
Zing因没能同行而发怒，Perda在实验室看见古老护身符和陶杯。
The Source of Magic in Danger
研究人员准备研究Wormwood树木片，Zing喷火飞向一本珍贵旧书，留下悬念。

questions.question: Why was the group magically shackled together while traveling through the vortex?

options.text: So no one would become separated in the vortex.
So they could carry the ancient relics together.
So Zing would stop breathing fire.
So the palace guards could arrest them.

questions.explanation: 大家在漩涡中用魔法锁链连成一排，是为了防止有人与团队分离。

questions.question: Why did Zann land in a puddle near the lab?

options.text: Perda had pushed him into the water.
Nax had sent him to the wrong city.
He could be careless when choosing exactly where to zap.
A dragon had knocked him off his broom.

questions.explanation: Zann虽然擅长魔法，但有时传送落点不够准确，因此踩进了水洼。

questions.question: How did Zann protect himself when Zing flew at him breathing fire?

options.text: He ran into the palace.
He cast a Shield spell.
He jumped through a wormhole.
He hid inside the relic case.

questions.explanation: Zing喷火冲过来时，Zann及时施放Shield魔法挡住火焰。

questions.question: Where had the most powerful relics been taken?

options.text: To Swamp Bottom to be hidden.
To the Cave of the Unknown.
To a shop near the lab.
To the palace for full-time protection.

questions.explanation: 研究员解释最强大的遗物已运往宫殿严密守护，实验室只留下少数研究。

questions.question: Why were the researchers interested in the piece of Wormwood tree?

options.text: The tree had been identified as the Source of magic.
The tree could make dragons sleep.
The wood was needed to repair a wagon.
The tree was a present from a king.

questions.explanation: Asta解释Wormwood树已被发现是魔法之源，因此研究人员想进一步研究木片。

title: New Developments
sections: Perda放出plonks分散Trof注意，协助Mellis与Anso逃离，但Zing被农夫捉走。
Mellis和Perda跟随人群来到Vilkor新建的豪宅，怀疑Zira正在操纵他。
A Compel Spell and a Sacrifice
两人受到Compel法术控制并被壮汉抓住，Mellis用魔法替Perda创造逃走机会。

questions.question: How did Perda distract Trof at the start of the escape?

options.text: She opened the fence so the plonks ran away.
She asked Vilkor to arrest Trof.
She hid inside a giant tree.
She turned Mellis into a dragon.

questions.explanation: Perda打开围栏放走plonks，Trof只好追赶动物，从而松开Mellis。

questions.question: What happened to Zing while Perda was trying to escape?

options.text: Zing flew safely back to Magica.
Anso took Zing to his house.
Trof grabbed the dragon and trapped him.
Zing transformed into a bird.

questions.explanation: Trof伸手从空中抓住Zing，把它关进装置里，迫使Perda暂时留下它。

questions.question: Why did Mellis want to follow the people heading to Vilkor's new house?

options.text: She wanted to receive a golden staff.
She hoped they might find Zann there.
She was searching for more plonks.
She wanted to ask Vilkor for a party invitation.

questions.explanation: Mellis猜测Zann可能已经回到新建的豪宅附近，因此建议暗中跟随人群。

questions.question: What caused Perda and Mellis to move against their will?

options.text: A sudden strong wind pushed them.
Anso called them from his home.
Zing used magic to lead them.
A Compel spell pulled them down the street.

questions.explanation: Perda辨认出这种不由自主被拖走的感觉像Compel强迫咒。

questions.question: How did Mellis give Perda a chance to escape from the goons?

options.text: She hit a goon with a magically created rock.
She opened a wormhole in the mansion.
She called the villagers to help.
She ordered Trof to release Zing.

questions.explanation: Mellis变出石头击中抓住Perda的打手，并催Perda赶快传送逃跑。

title: An Important Decision
sections: Perda魔力不足，Zann和她在树林里躲避追兵，却不愿立即离开。
A Troubling Story in the Cave
Zann坦白矿工Yarb被卷进漩涡的经过，Perda劝他先解决眼前危机。
两人讨论是否先回Magica求援，最后决定留在当地营救Mellis与Zing。

questions.question: Why could Perda not simply zap the two friends away herself?

options.text: She had used almost all her magic energy reaching the woods.
She had forgotten where Magica was.
Zann had forbidden all magic spells.
There were no spells in her spellbook.

questions.explanation: Perda从村庄传送到树林已消耗很多魔力，难以继续带两人传送。

questions.question: Why did Zann refuse to leave the woods immediately?

options.text: He wanted to find more food in the forest.
He was waiting for the plonk farmer.
He was troubled by something that had happened to a miner.
He needed to repair the dragon coach.

questions.explanation: Zann因矿工Yarb卷入漩涡而内疚，不愿立刻放弃寻找他的可能。

questions.question: What did Zann feel responsible for?

options.text: Mellis losing her magic forever.
A miner being sucked into the vortex.
Trof losing his entire farm.
Zira destroying the village well.

questions.explanation: Zann认为自己造成矿工掉进漩涡，甚至想进去救他。

questions.question: What had Mellis done to help Perda escape?

options.text: She trapped Zira inside the laboratory.
She drove the dragons back to First City.
She asked Vilkor to take her place.
She sacrificed her freedom by distracting the goons.

questions.explanation: Mellis利用新魔法牵制打手，让Perda有机会传送离开，自己却被留下。

questions.question: What did Zann finally agree to do before returning to Magica?

options.text: Go back to the village to rescue Mellis and Zing.
Wait in the cave until morning.
Tell the miners how to use dark magic.
Travel through the wormhole without Perda.

questions.explanation: Perda提醒他不能抛下Mellis和Zing，Zann最终同意先回村救人。

title: Strange Behavior
sections: Zira没有因孩子们擅自传送而惩罚他们，反而盛情款待并夸奖Vilkor。
孩子们讨论Trof被关进地牢的事，向Vilkor说明危险并请求他阻止Zira。
Vilkor想向Zira交涉，却被闯进来的Krub打断；Krub指控Zann是杀人犯。

questions.question: What puzzled Zann about Zira's treatment of the children?

options.text: She treated them like royalty instead of punishing them.
She ordered them to leave the banquet before dessert.
She claimed she had never met them.
She refused to let them talk to Mellis.

questions.explanation: Zira知道孩子们擅自传送并释放了Trof，却没有惩罚，反而像贵宾一样款待。

questions.question: Why did Zann think Zira was praising Vilkor so much?

options.text: She had just discovered his secret magical talent.
She believed he had rescued every villager.
She was flattering him so he would do what she wanted.
She hoped he would teach her to zap.

questions.explanation: Zann看出Zira夸奖Vilkor是为了利用他的虚荣心，影响他的决定。

questions.question: Why did Mellis think Zira punished Trof so cruelly?

options.text: Trof had stolen the palace's ancient relics.
She might have wanted to frighten the other villagers.
She wanted to reward him with a dungeon room.
Trof had refused to attend the banquet.

questions.explanation: Mellis怀疑Zira用残酷惩罚来恐吓其他村民，也可能阻止他们靠近井边。

questions.question: How did Vilkor initially react after hearing about Trof and the gorzogs?

options.text: He immediately released Trof himself.
He denied that Zira existed.
He promised to move everyone back to Magica.
He said security was Zira's responsibility and largely dismissed the concern.

questions.explanation: Vilkor起初认为Trof也许活该，安保由Zira决定，未认真处理孩子们的担忧。

questions.question: What dramatic accusation ended the episode?

options.text: Krub demanded Zann's arrest, calling him a murderer.
Zira accused Vilkor of stealing gold.
Trof confessed that he had hidden Zing.
Perda claimed she had destroyed the wormhole.

questions.explanation: Krub突然闯入，指着Zann要求Zira将他作为杀人犯逮捕，形成悬念。
